verdict.rationale: Cerebras documents deploying custom fine-tuned models on dedicated endpoints, uploading them from your S3 bucket and tracking versions through the Management API. There is no evidence that the platform performs the fine-tuning itself, so training has to happen elsewhere. Serving is also limited to private dedicated endpoints, not the public self-serve tier. Missing for 10: an on-platform fine-tuning or training job API, a documented list of supported base models for tuning, an end-to-end tune-then-serve workflow on one platform, and independent or hands-on corroboration of fine-tuned model deployment.
